meta.title.text: Touch Typing — A Skill for the Digital Age

meta.description.text: Master touch typing: an interactive keyboard, a speed test, a 30-day plan and five Typing Race 2026 trainers.

meta.ogTitle.text: Think about the content. Your fingers will find the keys.

meta.ogDescription.text: Your start in touch typing. 5 trainers, 3 layouts, 30 days of practice.

hero.text1.text: A SKILL FOR THE DIGITAL AGE

hero.text3.text: Touch typing is an essential digital skill for study, work and creativity. Learn the ten-finger method and reach a new level of working with your computer.

hero.text4.text: No sign-up · At your own pace · 10–15 min a day

learn.heading1.text:
Eyes on the text.
Fingers know the way.

learn.text2.text: Touch typing means typing with all ten fingers without looking at the keyboard. Instead of hunting for each letter, you gradually memorize the movement.

learn.text3.text: Press a key on the diagram to see which finger types it.

learn.altgr.text: AltGr layer: ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż

learn.keyTip.text: F and J: your index fingers. Feel for the bumps on these keys.

keyboard.noteUk.text: Ukrainian ЙЦУКЕН. Home row: Ф І В А · О Л Д Ж. Ґ may need a separate key or a key combination, depending on your OS.

learn.text4.text: Left hand on A S D F, right hand on J K L ;. Your thumbs take care of the space bar.

learn.text5.text: Relax your shoulders, keep your wrists straight and don’t rest them on the edge of the desk. The diagram shows finger zones, not the shape of a particular keyboard.

learn.text6.text: The right finger and accuracy come first. If you make many mistakes, slow down. Instead of glancing down, bring your attention back to the text.

benefits.heading1.text: Fewer movements between thought and text.

benefits.text2.text: Fewer pauses to find keys when you write an email or fill in a document.

benefits.text3.text: Follow the sentence on the screen and shape your thought without searching for every letter.

benefits.text4.text: Documents, code, messages and AI prompts—the skill pays off every day.

benefits.text5.text: It’s easier to write down your own ideas and notes and to complete written assignments.

benefits.text6.text: Getting to know the keyboard builds confidence in children and adults.

benefits.text7.text: A practical foundation for managers, analysts, programmers and office teams.

calculator.text2.text: How many minutes would you get back if you typed the same text faster?

calculator.text3.text: For conversion, 1 standard word = 5 characters including spaces. Typing time only: volume ÷ current speed − volume ÷ target speed. Time for thinking and editing is not included. 5 working days a week, 20 a month.

test.text2.text: Check your starting pace. Connect a physical keyboard, choose the English layout and start typing.

test.text3.text: Type the text below for {$1}. The countdown starts with the first character. When time is up, your result will appear.

test.text4.text: Your result has been recorded. Press “Try again” to start a new test.

test.label7.text: Type the text from the sample

test.testStatus.text: The timer starts with the first character.

test.text5.text: SPM = correct characters ÷ minutes. WPM = SPM ÷ 5. A standard word is 5 characters; spaces and punctuation count. The counter shows correct and total characters in the typed text. Accuracy counts every character you type, including corrected mistakes. Apostrophes ' / ’ / ʼ are treated the same. Pasting is disabled. Nothing is sent or stored.

trainers.text2.text: Five different approaches from Typing Race 2026. Choose by your goal: a step-by-step course, analytics, a game or races.

trainers.text3.text: Based on the audit results announced on October 6, 2026. This is an assessment of competition entries, not a ranking of how well each trainer suits every learner.

trainers.text6.text: “Гами” was submitted after the evaluation ended. Touch Type Race Academy is the organizer’s own entry, outside the competition.

trainers.text7.text: Sources: index.html, the sites/ descriptions and ANNOUNCEMENT.md from the hackathon materials. Illustrations of trainer features.

plan.text2.text: Set aside 10–15 minutes a day. Take breaks and come back to the difficult keys. A specific speed after 30 days is not guaranteed.

plan.text3.text: Finger placement and the home row. Slow drills without looking down.

plan.text4.text: Top and bottom rows, numbers, Shift. Add keys gradually.

plan.text5.text: Short words and common letter pairs. A steady pace and working on mistakes.

plan.text6.text: Emails, notes, real texts. Compare your result with day one.

plan.storageNote.text: Mark the days you complete. Progress is saved only in this browser and does not sync between devices.

music.text2.text: Five songs from the Touch Type Race collection. Pick a mood for your next practice session.

music.text3.text: Songs play only after you press Play. One track plays at a time; starting the test pauses the music.

about.heading1.text:
From an idea
to a useful app.

about.text2.text: Typing Race 2026 is a hackathon for educational typing trainers. Its goal is a step-by-step learning path in which accuracy and correct movements come before speed.

about.text3.text: AI can help with interface design, coding, tests and documentation. A person defines the task, checks the result and is responsible for the quality of learning. This page makes no assumptions about which models individual authors used.

about.link1.text: Try the results of this work ↗

finalCta.heading1.text:
Put your fingers on A S D F.
And begin.

footer.text1.text: A skill that stays with you.

catalog.solo.description.text: A step-by-step touch typing course: from your first keys to confident typing.

catalog.solo.feature1.text: A final check without the on-screen keyboard or hints: you need 3 successful attempts in a row.

catalog.solo.feature2.text: The accuracy threshold is visible before you start; the speed and accuracy formulas are shown in the interface.

catalog.solo.feature3.text: Progress is saved in your browser.

catalog.solo.imageAlt.text: Illustration: hands on the home row, with steps made of keys leading to a sheet of text and three marks for successful attempts.

catalog.typing-race.description.text: A learning system with finger hints, detailed analytics and races with friends.

catalog.typing-race.feature1.text: After each exercise: errors by character, your slowest transition, rhythm and advice on what to practice next.

catalog.typing-race.feature2.text: Races in a private room joined by code, with your opponent’s live progress and a leaderboard.

catalog.typing-race.feature3.text: Themes, text size up to 40 px and a reduced-motion mode.

catalog.typing-race.imageAlt.text: Illustration: three cars on a race track next to an analytics card with charts and a keyboard highlighting mistakes.

catalog.typtap.description.text: A trainer with mini-games and multiplayer: learning that easily turns into a game.

catalog.typtap.feature1.text: 16 mini-games and a single-text race for up to 8 players.

catalog.typtap.feature2.text: The “Weak keys” mode picks exercises based on your mistakes.

catalog.typtap.feature3.text: Your own text: paste it or upload a .txt or .md file.

catalog.typtap.imageAlt.text: Illustration: eight smiling player characters above four mini-games made of keys.

catalog.gamy.description.text: Exercises like piano scales: a short movement, one goal and new difficulty only once you have mastered the last step.

catalog.gamy.feature1.text: A final check without the keyboard or hints, an accuracy threshold of 95–97%, 3 successful attempts in a row.

catalog.gamy.feature2.text: Error breakdown, slowest transitions, a rhythm chart and a “Weak spots” exercise.

catalog.gamy.feature3.text: Works offline as an app (PWA) and sends nothing over the network.

catalog.gamy.imageAlt.text: Illustration: a finger pressing keys that rise like a piano scale, with a musical staff above them.

catalog.academy.description.text: A large trainer with races: solo, against a bot or online, in three languages.

catalog.academy.feature1.text: “Solo”, “Against AI” (4 bot speeds) and “Online” modes, with rooms for 2, 4 or 6 players.

catalog.academy.feature2.text: Ukrainian, English and Polish; up to six profiles on one computer.

catalog.academy.feature3.text: Post-race analytics, a daily practice counter and achievements.

catalog.academy.imageAlt.text: Illustration: three cars in flag colors racing down a road, with a robot holding a checkered flag and an online-game globe beside them.
